Subject: IRP snapshot + SIG workbook request for procurement

Hi Jasmine,

We're in the final stages of the vendor security review for Redwood and need a few artifacts to close the procurement checklist on our side:

- A current Incident Response Plan snapshot (IRP) or a short export that outlines roles, escalation paths, and communication templates.
- Completed SIG (Standardized Information Gathering) workbook (we can accept a partially filled workbook and follow up).
- If available, a small redacted sample of an incident timeline (postmortem) — we just need the structure and a short excerpt to see your fidelity.
- Any CAIQ pointers or where you host your security questionnaire answers.

Can you confirm what you can share by EOD Feb 18? If there's an internal approval or a data handling addendum we need to sign, let me know. I've attached our evidence checklist to make it easier to map items.

Thanks — we want to keep the purchasing timeline intact and this would unblock procurement.

Laura Cheng
Head of Security, Nimbus Health

@Stephanie — can you confirm which items in the attached checklist require SOC2 attestation vs operational evidence so we can prioritize?
